protocol.images: 1,000 ImageNet-100 validation images, the first ten sorted image ids of each class
protocol.extraction: vtb.extract at 448 px, 4x4 pooled tokens, BF16, every tapped Tower depth plus merged and projected; one H100; batch size per Tower in extraction_batch_size
protocol.channel_rms: uncentered root mean square of each channel over all 16,000 tokens
protocol.pc1_share: variance share of the first of 512 probe_run.fit_reducer components, training split of probe_run.split_indices(1000)
protocol.final_readout: final Tower layer; matched attention readout; 20 epochs; batch 256; seeds 0-2; scored on the 300 validation and test images. label_1pct trains on probe_run.subsample_train(split, 0.01), 100 images, at the published 1% learning rate. label_full trains on all 700 training images at the published full-label learning rate, which is only 60 optimizer steps. MiMo has no label-budget cells, so it uses 1e-3 and 1e-4. Patched cells standardize every channel on training-split tokens before fit_reducer, as the R2 patch does.
